title: DAGR SRS deterministic verification report (frozen v0.1)
description: Deterministic results of one ARCS Verify invocation over one signed DAGR SRS receipt (srs.mcp.sdk_enforcement.v0.1 only). Contains no wall-clock time, random identifiers, hostnames, or temporary paths. Unknown fields fail closed: this schema defines no extension location.

report_version.description: Version of this report contract, not the arcs-verify package version.

receipt_id.description: Verbatim receipt_id copied from the verified receipt.

receipt_kind.description: This v0.1 contract covers only the DAGR MCP receipt-emitter/runtime binding's admission and outcome receipt kinds under srs.mcp.sdk_enforcement.v0.1. Other profiles (e.g. srs.connection.lifecycle.v0.1) are out of scope.

receipt_artifact_hash.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS(complete accepted receipt JSON object, including receipt_signature)), lowercase hex, no prefix. Defined authoritatively in receipt-hash-contract.json. Distinct from the Ed25519 signature preimage (see receipt_signature_verification in the same file).

supported_receipt_contract_id.description: Verbatim profile_id identity this report was verified against, per supported-receipt-contract.json.

supported_receipt_contract_version.description: Verbatim profile_version identity this report was verified against.

verifier_commit.description: Full git commit SHA of the arcs-verify checkout that performed this verification. Never a mutable ref such as 'main' or 'latest'.

verifier_entrypoint.description: The pinned console-script target (see [project.scripts] in pyproject.toml, exposed as the 'arcs-verify' command) that performs the eight-Boolean verification this report wraps.

verifier_configuration_digest.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS) over {envelope_schema_sha256, receipt_version, selected_profile} as defined in execution-contract.json.

trust_bundle_digest.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS(complete trust-bundle JSON object)) actually used for this verification. Recording this digest does not assert the trust bundle was authorized; only that it is the exact artifact used.

verdicts.description: Exactly the eight existing Boolean ARCS verdict fields. chain_status is NOT a ninth verdict and MUST NOT appear here.

chain_status.description: Reported separately from verdicts, never a ninth Boolean. This v0.1 contract only reaches not_applicable for standalone signed DAGR receipts; a widened domain requires a new contract version.

failure_codes.description: Deterministic failure-code strings from the underlying verification (never raw receipt content or free-form error text).
